name: windsor-ai-google-merchant-center
description:
Bring your own Google Merchant Center product feed and Shopping performance data into your AI assistant with Windsor.ai, so you can explore it in plain English and update your products after you confirm.

Reporting examples:
- Rank products by Shopping clicks, impressions and CTR, by day, week or month.
- Find products with high impressions but few clicks.
- Break down clicks and impressions by Google product category, by your own product type, or by feed label.
- Count active, disapproved, pending and expiring products by destination, such as Shopping ads and free listings, and by country.
- Compare product prices with price benchmarks, and list the products priced furthest above or below their benchmark.
- See the suggested price for a product, with the predicted change in clicks, impressions and conversions.
- Rank products by click potential to find the ones that could get more clicks.
- Report conversions and conversion rate by product for free listings.
- See which competitor domains show up next to yours in a category and country: their rank, relative visibility, page overlap rate and how often they are shown above you.
- List the top merchants in a category and country, and compare your visibility trend with the category benchmark.
- Audit product data: list products with a missing GTIN, MPN, brand, image link or Google product category.
- List products that are out of stock or on sale, with sale price and sale dates.
- List your data sources with their type, input (API, file, UI or autofeed), countries and feed label.

Feed status is current; date ranges apply to performance metrics. Google Ads campaign spend is outside this connector.

Discover connected accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query product, price and competitive visibility metrics over any date range.

Changes it can make, always after you confirm:
- Update a product's title, description, price, sale price, availability, link, images, brand, GTIN, product category and custom labels.
- Fill in or correct a product attribute, such as a GTIN the product data audit shows as missing, or a wrong price.
- Pause a product in ads or everywhere, and end the pause.
- Add a new product, or delete one.
- Create an API data source: a primary one for products you add, or a supplemental one whose values override your feed.

Common workflows:
- See which products got the most clicks and impressions last month
- Find the products that lost the most clicks against the previous month
- Check how many products are disapproved or pending in each country
- Compare your prices against benchmarks
- Find products where a lower price is predicted to bring more clicks
- See which competitor domains are shown above you most often in your main category
- Change the price of a product that is priced above its benchmark
- Fill in the missing GTIN or brand of the products the data audit finds

How changes work: products are written through an API data source in your Merchant Center account. A product that comes from a file feed, an app or the Merchant Center UI is changed through a supplemental API data source, and its values override the feed until you remove them. Merchant Center shows a change after a few minutes.

Not included: the reason a single product is disapproved (product status is returned as counts), editing your feed file, feed rules, promotions, shipping and tax settings, and Google Ads Shopping campaigns.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google Merchant Center is a trademark of Google LLC.

defaultPrompt: How many of my Google Merchant Center products are disapproved, pending or expiring, by destination and country?
Show me Google Merchant Center products with high impressions but low click-through rate over the last 30 days.
Compare price competitiveness and availability across product categories in Google Merchant Center for the last 90 days.
capabilities: Analyze Google Merchant Center product and Shopping clicks, impressions and CTR
Count disapproved, pending, expiring and active Merchant Center products by destination and country
Compare Merchant Center product prices with price benchmarks and suggested prices
Update Merchant Center product titles, prices, availability and other attributes after you confirm
Add, pause or delete Merchant Center products and create API data sources after you confirm
See competitor domains, top merchants and visibility trends in your Shopping categories
Discover connected Google Merchant Center accounts, reporting fields and options

positive.prompt: Which Google Merchant Center accounts are connected to Windsor.ai?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists connected Merchant Center accounts so the user can choose which one to analyze.

positive.prompt: For my Merchant Center account, show the valid fields and options for a product report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns usable field IDs and connector options for a Google Merchant Center report.

positive.prompt: How many of my Google Merchant Center products are active, disapproved, pending or expiring, by destination and country?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns product status counts by reporting context and country using valid Merchant Center fields, and says that the connector does not return per-product disapproval reasons.

positive.prompt: Show me products with high impressions but low CTR over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns product-level impression and CTR data using valid Merchant Center fields.

positive.description: Help a user connect the Merchant Center connector.
positive.prompt: I have not connected Google Merchant Center yet. Give me the setup link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Windsor.ai setup URL for connecting or authorizing the Google Merchant Center connector.

positive.description: Prepare a product price change, gated on explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: Find a product in my Merchant Center account that is priced above its price benchmark and prepare a price change to match the benchmark. Show the current and proposed price and wait for my approval before changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads product prices and price benchmarks, names one product, inspects the update_product schema, shows the current price, the proposed price and the data source the change would be written to, and waits for explicit confirmation before running execute_action; it makes no change on its own.

negative.description: Public market data, not the user's account.
negative.prompt: What are the best-selling product categories on Google Shopping this year?
Write product titles and descriptions for my new line of running shoes.

negative.description: General explanation unrelated to connected accounts.
negative.prompt: Explain how Google Shopping decides which products to show for a search.

review.commerce_description: Windsor.ai does not sell products, show plans, or process payments in the app.

publication.release_notes: Add reporting examples to the description: competitor domains and top merchants, suggested prices, click potential, conversions for free listings, product status counts, product data audits and data sources. Describe product status as counts by destination and country, which is what the connector returns, in the description, the first starter prompt, one review case, three capability labels and the skill. Add 57 keywords. Title, subtitle, MCP configuration and write actions unchanged. No server behavior changes.
